description: This file defines various enums and types related to icon states within the application, including session roles, tool kinds, activity kinds, and how icons are represented and overridden based on activity state.

methods.name: badgeSymbolName
methods.description: Returns the name of the symbol for the icon badge based on current activity

methods.name: badgeProminence
methods.description: Returns the prominence level of the badge if applicable

methods.name: isWorking
methods.description: Returns whether the icon state indicates an ongoing activity

methods.name: toIconState
methods.description: Converts an override selection to a corresponding IconState
